newsitem.title: CANADA: Trilon Financial to issue 10-yr debenture.
newsitem.headline: Trilon Financial to issue 10-yr debenture.

text.p: Trilon Financial Corp said on Wednesday said it filed a preliminary prospectus relating to the issue of 10-year Canadian dollar denominated debentures in Canada.
The company said the amount, terms and pricing of the issue would be determined when regulatory approvals were obtained. The issue was expected to be completed in mid-March.

The proceeds of the issue would be used for general corporate purposes, Trilon said. Those purposes may include expansion of its investment banking and commercial financing operations and repayment of existing bank facilities as they came due.
The debentures have been rated B++ (High) by Canadian Bond Rating Service and BBB (high) by Dominion Bond Rating Service.
The issue was being underwritten by Goldman Sachs Canada, CIBC Wood Gundy Securities Inc, TD Securities Inc, Midland Walwyn Capital Inc and Trilon Securities Corp, the company said.
